info.title: Gradiated API
info.description: The Gradiated API covers inference, model discovery, workspaces, billing, API keys and usage. Inference endpoints use workspace API keys (Authorization: Bearer or x-api-key). These keys do not authorize workspace administration. Protected management endpoints require a signed-in user session and the appropriate organization role; management API keys are not currently supported. Management request bodies are limited to 1 MiB (413 if exceeded). Management per-IP limits are 300 requests/minute, or 10/minute for waitlist signups, per API process. Rate-limited requests return 429 with Retry-After. Stripe webhooks are excluded from the IP rate limits.
